# SidePanel

The default and `form` variants retain a row title container. The opt-in
`participants` variant keeps its column title/subtitle container and dedicated
spacing and typography; restoring the default layout does not change it.

A slide-in overlay panel with a fixed header, scrollable body, and a `StatefulButton` footer that supports inline loading, success, and error feedback.

```ts
import { SidePanel } from '@wfm/ui-components';
```

## Basic Usage

Pass `visible` and `onClose` to control the panel. Use `title` for the header heading and `actions` for the footer buttons. The panel body composes a real "Import historical data" form using `Typography` (subtitle + helper notes), `UploadFile` (drop zone with template link), `InteractiveMessage` (info banner), `Choice` (radio + checkbox), `Dropdown`, and `FormField` for label / required / helper composition.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Choice,
  Dropdown,
  FormField,
  InteractiveMessage,
  SidePanel,
  Typography,
  UploadFile,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

const fileFormatOptions = [
  { label: 'WFM', value: 'wfm' },
  { label: 'Zendesk', value: 'zendesk' },
];

const dateFormatOptions = [
  { label: 'MM/dd/yyyy', value: 'MM/dd/yyyy' },
  { label: 'dd/MM/yyyy', value: 'dd/MM/yyyy' },
  { label: 'yyyy-MM-dd', value: 'yyyy-MM-dd' },
];

const intervalOptions = [
  { label: '15 min', value: '15' },
  { label: '30 min', value: '30' },
  { label: '60 min', value: '60' },
];

const timezoneOptions = [
  { label: '(UTC+00:00) Lisbon', value: 'Europe/Lisbon' },
  { label: '(UTC+01:00) Madrid', value: 'Europe/Madrid' },
  { label: '(UTC-05:00) New York', value: 'America/New_York' },
  { label: '(UTC-08:00) Los Angeles', value: 'America/Los_Angeles' },
];

export default function Demo() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  const [fileFormat, setFileFormat] = useState('wfm');
  const [timezone, setTimezone] = useState(null);
  const [dateFormat, setDateFormat] = useState('MM/dd/yyyy');
  const [interval, setInterval] = useState('15');
  const [updateForecast, setUpdateForecast] = useState(false);

  const handleClose = () => {
    setOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button type="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Import historical data
      </Button>
      <SidePanel
        actions={[
          {
            label: 'Cancel',
            type: 'secondary',
            onClick: handleClose,
            'data-qa': 'cancel',
          },
          {
            label: 'Import',
            type: 'primary',
            disabled: !file || !timezone,
            onClick: handleClose,
            'data-qa': 'submit',
          },
        ]}
        title="Import historical data"
        visible={open}
        onClose={handleClose}
        data-qa="import-side-panel"
      >
        {/* Force every FormField inside this panel to fill the body width.
            Exclude checkbox/radio inputs so Choice labels keep their natural width. */}
        <style>{`
          [data-qa="import-side-panel"] [data-component="WFMFormField"],
          [data-qa="import-side-panel"] [data-component="WFMFormField"] input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]),
          [data-qa="import-side-panel"] [data-component="WFMFormField"] [class*="Dropdown"],
          [data-qa="import-side-panel"] [data-component="WFMFormField"] [class*="dropdown"] { width: 100%; }
        `}</style>
        <Flex direction="column" gap="4" width="100%">
          <Typography variant="body" tone="subdued">
            Choose the relevant file with your historical data to upload.
          </Typography>

          <FormField label="File upload" isRequired>
            <UploadFile
              file={file}
              accept=".csv"
              maxSizeBytes={10 * 1024 * 1024}
              description="Only .csv files up to 10MB are supported"
              templateUrl="#"
              onFileChange={setFile}
              data-qa="history-file-upload"
            />
          </FormField>

          <InteractiveMessage variation="info">
            Accept historical data within 3 years of today only.
          </InteractiveMessage>

          <FormField label="File format">
            <Flex gap="6">
              {fileFormatOptions.map((opt) => (
                <Choice
                  key={opt.value}
                  type="radio"
                  name="file-format"
                  value={opt.value}
                  checked={fileFormat === opt.value}
                  onChange={() => setFileFormat(opt.value)}
                  label={opt.label}
                  data-qa={`file-format-${opt.value}`}
                />
              ))}
            </Flex>
          </FormField>

          <FormField label="Timezone" isRequired>
            <Dropdown
              value={timezone}
              options={timezoneOptions}
              onChange={(v) => setTimezone(v)}
              messages={{ placeholder: 'Select timezone' }}
              data-qa="timezone-dropdown"
            />
          </FormField>

          <FormField
            label="File date format"
            isRequired
            description="Time format supported: HH:mm:ss"
          >
            <Dropdown
              value={dateFormat}
              options={dateFormatOptions}
              onChange={(v) => setDateFormat(v)}
              data-qa="date-format-dropdown"
            />
          </FormField>

          <FormField label="Interval granularity" isRequired>
            <Dropdown
              value={interval}
              options={intervalOptions}
              onChange={(v) => setInterval(v)}
              data-qa="interval-dropdown"
            />
          </FormField>

          <FormField
            label="Forecast and schedules update"
            isRequired
            description="If selected, WFM will run the forecast and schedules immediately after importing the history file."
          >
            <Choice
              checked={updateForecast}
              onChange={(checked) => setUpdateForecast(checked)}
              label="Update forecast and schedules after import"
              data-qa="update-forecast-choice"
            />
          </FormField>
        </Flex>
      </SidePanel>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Inline Loading State

Set `state="inline-loading"` on an action to show a spinner inside the button during an async save. The `disabled` prop on every action prevents double-submission and locks the form while the request is in flight. Once the operation completes, restore `state` to `undefined`. The body reuses the full `FormField` composition from Basic Usage so users can fill the form, then click Save to simulate a 2-second submit.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Choice,
  DatePicker,
  Dropdown,
  FormField,
  MultiDropdown,
  SidePanel,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Input from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-input';

const priorityOptions = [
  { value: 'low', label: 'Low' },
  { value: 'medium', label: 'Medium' },
  { value: 'high', label: 'High' },
];

const tagOptions = [
  { label: 'Onboarding', value: 'onboarding' },
  { label: 'Coaching', value: 'coaching' },
  { label: 'Compliance', value: 'compliance' },
  { label: 'Quality', value: 'quality' },
];

export default function Demo() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('Weekly review');
  const [priority, setPriority] = useState('medium');
  const [tags, setTags] = useState([]);
  const [date, setDate] = useState(null);
  const [recurring, setRecurring] = useState(false);

  const handleSave = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setLoading(false);
      setOpen(false);
    }, 2000);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button type="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Edit schedule
      </Button>
      <SidePanel
        actions={[
          {
            label: 'Cancel',
            type: 'secondary',
            disabled: loading,
            onClick: () => setOpen(false),
            'data-qa': 'cancel',
          },
          {
            label: 'Save',
            type: 'primary',
            disabled: loading || !title,
            state: loading ? 'inline-loading' : undefined,
            onClick: handleSave,
            'data-qa': 'save',
          },
        ]}
        title="Edit schedule"
        visible={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        data-qa="loading-side-panel"
      >
        {/* Force every FormField inside this panel to fill the body width.
            Scoped to [data-component="WFMFormField"] so Choice (a bare Flex
            sibling of the FormFields) is not affected and its checkbox
            stays its natural size. */}
        <style>{`
          [data-qa="loading-side-panel"] [data-component="WFMFormField"],
          [data-qa="loading-side-panel"] [data-component="WFMFormField"] input,
          [data-qa="loading-side-panel"] [data-component="WFMFormField"] [class*="Dropdown"],
          [data-qa="loading-side-panel"] [data-component="WFMFormField"] [class*="dropdown"] { width: 100%; }
        `}</style>
        <Flex direction="column" gap="4" width="100%">
          <FormField
            label="Title"
            htmlFor="schedule-title"
            isRequired
            variation={!title ? 'error' : undefined}
            errorHint={!title ? 'Title is required.' : undefined}
          >
            <Input
              id="schedule-title"
              value={title}
              placeholder="e.g. Weekly 1:1"
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              disabled={loading}
              style={{ width: '100%' }}
              data-qa="schedule-title-input"
            />
          </FormField>

          <FormField label="Priority" isRequired>
            <Dropdown
              value={priority}
              options={priorityOptions}
              onChange={(v) => setPriority(v)}
              disabled={loading}
              messages={{ placeholder: 'Select priority' }}
              data-qa="priority-dropdown"
            />
          </FormField>

          <FormField
            label="Tags"
            description="Help your team filter and find this schedule later."
          >
            <MultiDropdown
              options={tagOptions}
              value={tags}
              onChange={(values) => setTags(values)}
              searchable
              disabled={loading}
              messages={{ placeholder: 'Select tags' }}
              data-qa="tags-multi-dropdown"
            />
          </FormField>

          <FormField label="Scheduled date">
            <DatePicker
              value={date}
              onChange={setDate}
              placeholder="Pick a date"
              isFullWidth
              data-qa="schedule-date"
            />
          </FormField>

          <Choice
            checked={recurring}
            onChange={(checked) => setRecurring(checked)}
            label="Repeat weekly"
            disabled={loading}
            data-qa="recurring-choice"
          />
        </Flex>
      </SidePanel>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Scrollable Body

When body content exceeds the panel height, the middle section scrolls independently. The header and footer remain fixed. This example fills the body with many items to demonstrate the scroll behaviour.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SidePanel, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

const items = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => `Row item ${i + 1}`);

export default function Demo() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <>
      <Button type="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Open panel (30 rows)
      </Button>
      <SidePanel
        actions={[
          { label: 'Close', type: 'secondary', onClick: () => setOpen(false) },
          { label: 'Apply', type: 'primary', onClick: () => setOpen(false) },
        ]}
        title="Long content"
        visible={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      >
        <Flex direction="column" gap="2">
          {items.map((item) => (
            <Typography variant="body" key={item}>
              {item}
            </Typography>
          ))}
        </Flex>
      </SidePanel>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Sizes

Use `size` to control the panel width. Available values match Cobalt's `Panel` sizes.

- `'small'` — narrow, suited for filter or confirmation panels
- `'medium'` (default) — standard form or detail panels
- `'large'` — wide panels for complex workflows
- `'xlarge'` — maximum width

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SidePanel } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  const [size, setSize] = useState(null);

  const close = () => setSize(null);

  return (
    <Flex gap="3" wrap>
      {['small', 'medium', 'large', 'xlarge'].map((s) => (
        <Button key={s} type="secondary" onClick={() => setSize(s)}>
          {s}
        </Button>
      ))}
      {size && (
        <SidePanel
          actions={[{ label: 'Close', type: 'primary', onClick: close }]}
          size={size}
          title={`Size: ${size}`}
          visible
          onClose={close}
        >
          <p>
            This panel uses <code>size="{size}"</code>.
          </p>
        </SidePanel>
      )}
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## No Footer Actions

Omit `actions` (or pass an empty array) to render the panel without a footer. This is useful for read-only detail panels or panels that manage their own submit logic inside the body.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SidePanel, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';

export default function Demo() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <>
      <Button type="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Open detail panel
      </Button>
      <SidePanel
        title="Agent details"
        visible={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      >
        <Typography variant="body">
          No footer — close using the × button or overlay click.
        </Typography>
      </SidePanel>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop             | Type                | Default          | Description                                                                     |
| ---------------- | ------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `visible`        | `boolean`           | —                | Controls panel visibility                                                       |
| `title`          | `string`            | —                | Heading text rendered in the fixed header                                       |
| `onClose`        | `() => void`        | —                | Called when the × button or overlay is clicked                                  |
| `actions`        | `SidePanelAction[]` | `[]`             | Footer action buttons, rendered right-aligned. Omit to hide the footer entirely |
| `size`           | `SidePanelSize`     | `'medium'`       | Panel width preset — `'small'`, `'medium'`, `'large'`, or `'xlarge'`            |
| `children`       | `ReactNode`         | —                | Content rendered in the scrollable body                                         |
| `data-qa`        | `string`            | —                | QA selector on the Panel element; close button appends `-close`                 |
| `data-component` | `string`            | `'WFMSidePanel'` | Component identifier                                                            |

## SidePanelAction Type

Each object in the `actions` array is spread onto a `StatefulButton`:

| Prop       | Type                                                    | Default       | Description                                          |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`    | `ReactNode`                                             | —             | Button label content                                 |
| `type`     | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'danger'`                  | `'secondary'` | Cobalt button type                                   |
| `state`    | `'loading' \| 'inline-loading' \| 'success' \| 'error'` | —             | StatefulButton state — shows spinner / icon in-place |
| `disabled` | `boolean`                                               | `false`       | Disables the button                                  |
| `onClick`  | `(e: MouseEvent) => void`                               | —             | Click handler                                        |
| `data-qa`  | `string`                                                | —             | QA selector for the individual button                |
